assumptions.claim: SP2V_LOGIC_HIGH parameter correctly identifies which state bits correspond to valid high levels for the sparse FSM encoding.
assumptions.risk: Mismatch would instantiate assertions for incorrect signal polarities, potentially missing FSM error detection coverage.

assumptions.claim: The hierarchical path u_aes_core.u_aes_control.gen_fsm[i].gen_fsm_p/n.u_aes_control_fsm_i.u_aes_control_fsm.u_state_regs exists and matches the instantiated FSM state register instance.
assumptions.risk: If the path changes, the assertion will be unresolved or bound to wrong signals, leading to false positives or missed detections.

uncertain_points.claim: The internal check logic of AesControlFsmCheck_A is not visible here; it is unknown whether it covers all possible illegal state transitions or only a subset.
uncertain_points.cond: When the FSM enters an illegal state
uncertain_points.risk: If the assertion misses some error states, a true FSM fault could go undetected, allowing corrupted control to compromise AES security operations (e.g., key, data, configuration).
